companies.name: Chimney Monkey
companies.h1: Chimney Monkey — chimney sweep and fireplace services, Chicago North Shore
companies.lede: What this Buffalo Grove company says it does, where it says it works, and which of its people appear on a certification body's own public roster. Every line below is labeled with where it came from.
companies.foundedNote: “Serving the North Shore Since 2017” on the company's own site.

membership.label: NCSG member company
membership.note: Chimney Monkey appears on the National Chimney Sweep Guild's own public member directory as a Voting Member, listed at 741 Hastings Dr, Buffalo Grove, IL 60089 with the phone number shown above. Checked 19 September 2026. Guild membership is a business subscription, not a competence test — it says the company pays dues and agrees to the guild's code, nothing about the work done on your roof.
membership.reportedSince: The company's own site says “NCSG Member since 2017”. The guild's directory shows membership today; it does not publish a start date, so the 2017 figure stays the company's own claim.

serviceGroups.title: Repair and masonry

companies.serviceStandardNote: The company's site describes its inspections as “NFPA 211 compliant”. NFPA 211 is the national standard that defines inspection Levels 1, 2 and 3; it is not a licence and no one audits the claim for you. Ask for the level in writing before the visit and for the findings in writing after it.
